verdict.rationale: Replit's own docs describe starting a build from a Replit Design template, which Agent turns into a functional website that can be previewed and published. This satisfies the 'template' branch of the story instead of starting from a blank prompt. The template evidence covers only Design/website templates, and community projects are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: evidence of starting from or remixing community projects, breadth of the template catalog beyond Design website templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt

citations.quote: Start from a Replit Design template, turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.
Build this selected template as a functional website. Preserve its visual design and make its navigation and contact actions work.
